title: Whistleblower threatened with planted child pornography before DC testimony
summary: Steven Greer tells of Whistleblower threatened with planted child pornography before DC testimony, about after c. 2009 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: A van pulls up SUV out in front of his house. His wife's at work and they have two young kids, boys. And the they say, "Look at your phone and your computer." And they had embedded child pornography all over it.

plain: Steven Greer, an activist who campaigns for the release of UFO secrets, tells of a whistleblower who was getting ready to testify in Washington, DC. According to Greer, an SUV pulled up outside the man's home while his wife was at work and their two young sons were there, and the people in it told him to check his phone and computer, where they had planted child pornography. Greer tells it as an example of how far some would go to keep people from speaking.
